extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A Context-sensitive Text-rich visual reasoning dataset consisting of 506 challenging instructions for LMMs evaluation, covering eight real-world scenarios with text-rich images.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.publisher: Proceedings of the 41st Intemational Conference on Machine Leaming, Vienna, Austria. PMLR 235, 2024.
extraction.citeAs: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng. CONTEXTUAL : Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. Proceedings of the 41st Intemational Conference on Machine Leaming, Vienna, Austria. PMLR 235, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were sourced from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, and existing VQA datasets. Authors were divided into two groups to manually annotate the images with instruction-response pairs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images sourced from LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA datasets.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images for Time, Shopping, Navigation & Abstract categories underwent manual filtering. For Application Usage, Web Usage, Infographic, and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes, heuristic-based filtering was performed using PaddleOCR to detect text, selecting the top 500 images with the highest number of words.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Authors were divided into two groups to annotate specific categories following provided guidelines. MTurk workers verified the correctness of each sample. Incorrect samples were filtered out, and each author group reviewed the samples created by the other group to ensure adherence to guidelines and filter out low-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: MTurk workers verified the correctness of each sample, finding 96% were annotated correctly. Incorrect samples were filtered out, and author groups cross-reviewed samples to ensure quality and adherence to guidelines.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and code are made available to the LMM community along with a continuously updated leaderboard.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset evaluates context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning in LMMs. The authors aimed to ensure images, instructions, and responses are not offensive to any social group.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Linguistic diversity and writing style of the human responses would change with different social groups, as annotators were mainly from the US.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Human baseline and evaluation rely on annotators mainly from the US, which may limit linguistic diversity and reflect specific writing styles. Future work should involve annotators from more diverse regions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning capabilities of large multimodal models (LMMs).
